text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs by reading error messages carefully and testing small parts of your program. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you see exactly what is happening inside your code. It is also important to follow a systematic approach: change one thing at a time and check the result before moving on. Finally, logging is a simple but powerful technique. By adding log messages to your code, you can track values and understand where problems appear. With patience and practice, debugging becomes much easier.
